result: Reviewed human UniProtKB entries read through rest.uniprot.org on 2026-10-21 (annotation updates of 2 September 2026). SLC13A2 (Q13183): low-affinity sodium-dicarboxylate cotransporter of the apical cell membrane that mediates the entry of succinate, citrate, fumarate and 2-oxoglutarate into the small intestine and renal proximal tubule, with a probable stoichiometry of 3 Na+ per divalent dicarboxylate; citrate is transported in protonated form as a divalent anion rather than the trivalent form normally found in blood; expressed in kidney and intestine. SLC13A5 (Q86YT5): high-affinity sodium/citrate cotransporter of the cell membrane that recognises the trivalent form of citrate at physiological pH, probably with 4 Na+; expressed most predominantly in the liver, with moderate expression in brain and testis. SLC25A1 (P53007): electroneutral antiporter of the mitochondrial inner membrane that exports citrate from mitochondria into the cytosol in exchange for malate. ACO2 (Q99798): mitochondrial aconitase isomerises citrate to isocitrate via cis-aconitate.
